_meta.rule: Every input below is either quoted from a source on sources.json or is an arithmetic derivation printed next to it. Nothing here is a guess. Amounts are USD; CNY amounts are converted at the dated board rate.

fx_board.note: The one-way margin is the cost of converting once, because you buy USD at the bank's selling rate and the mid is the fair midpoint. The 0.42% round-trip figure that circulates as 'the spread' is twice that and describes converting there and back.

boc_personal_remittance.note: Commission runs on the CNY equivalent of the remitted amount and is capped at CNY 260, so the effective rate collapses as the amount grows.

full_amount_service.note: Optional 'full amount arrival' service: you pay the overseas bank's fee up front so the principal arrives intact. Omitted from the headline totals and shown as a separate column, because it is a corporate price list and its applicability to a personal remittance is unverified (F-06).

receiving_bank_us.note: A US bank's inbound-wire fee is bank-specific and no official schedule for the account in question was retrieved. Left blank on purpose (F-07); add your own bank's published inbound fee to the totals.

quota.note: Art. 54: annual facilitation quota for individual settlement and for domestic-individual purchase alike, per person per calendar year.

aml_verification.note: Art. 34: any outbound remittance at or above RMB 5,000 or USD 1,000 equivalent requires the institution to verify the remitter's identity data. It is a verification threshold, not a cap and not a quota.

emigration_transfer.note: Art. 6: whole amount applied for once; first release no more than half, a year later no more than half the remainder, two years later the rest; below RMB 200,000 one release is allowed. Art. 10: local SAFE approval up to RMB 500,000, above that SAFE head office.

cash.note: Art. 89: USD 5,000-10,000 outbound needs a bank-issued carriage permit; above USD 10,000 a SAFE permit is required and only for destinations with war-risk or similar conditions. The model uses the USD 5,000 no-permit tier per trip; travel cost is not modelled (F-09).

penalties_cn.note: Arts. 39/40/45: a fine of up to 30% of the amount, or 30%-100% where the case is serious, plus confiscation of illegal gains; criminal referral where the threshold is met. Arts. 39/45 fines attach to the amount involved, which is a statutory range and not an assessment of any case.

penalties_us.note: Willful FBAR penalty is the greater of the statutorily adjusted USD 165,353 or 50% of the balance at the time of the violation, per violation. Non-willful adjusted maximum USD 16,536. Form 8938 maximum USD 60,000. All are maximums, not assessments.
